travellers.name: Noll
travellers.summary: Knows where an object will part before touching it. Keeps a ledger of the pieces that should not have been separated.
hints: Hard stone and compacted ground keep sharp edges when they break. The pieces could be fitted together again after the whole fails.
Useful material is concentrated in a few narrow seams rather than spread across the ground. Separate pieces should be easy to recover.

diaryPages.prose: Hard stone and compacted ground keep sharp edges when they break. The pieces could be fitted together again after the whole fails.
Useful material is concentrated in a few narrow seams rather than spread across the ground. Separate pieces should be easy to recover.
Vance prices the whole object. I price the sound parts, subtract the work of separating them, and ask why the damaged joint is being hidden. Our totals usually agree. He finds this irritating.
Halloway repairs objects I would dismantle. When she says a piece can be mended, let her try. When she says it cannot, stop asking. She has already tried in her head three times.
Write hard material in a few clear seams. I can separate a clean boundary, count what came out, and leave the rest intact. Scattered fragments take longer and encourage sloppy sorting.

travellers.name: Halloway
travellers.summary: Kept the fire in. Says a forge is only a fire someone stayed with.
hints: The heat here does half the work for you.
The ground gives when it is worked, and holds when it cools.

diaryPages.prose: The heat here does half the work for you.
The ground gives when it is worked, and holds when it cools.
Give me heat and ground I can shape. I can carry tools, fuel and iron; I cannot carry a workable floor in my pockets.
A few gold flecks will waste an afternoon. A continuous vein can be cut, weighed and worked. Follow the stone before celebrating the shine.
A brush needs a thin ferrule that grips an even bundle without cutting the fibres. Bring Isolde workable metal; I will test the seam and replace it if it slips.

travellers.name: Mara
travellers.summary: Measured things for a living. Still does, out of habit.
hints: At its brightest, the horizon burns white enough to swallow my sighting line.

diaryPages.prose: At its brightest, the horizon burns white enough to swallow my sighting line.
Sela took the north path with two days of food and enough confidence for four. If the path was wrong, she will have found a better one by now.
I tried to sight across the slope and found the ground had stopped pretending to be gradual. A scarp: steep face, abrupt rise, no sensible route straight up.
Give me one fixed horizon, ridge or shoreline and I can measure the rest against it. Write that reference first; interpretation can wait until we have observations.
A crystal cut in the stone repeats the same crooked horizon from every face. I checked the instrument twice. The distortion belongs to the cavern.
Tovin counted distance by the bindings needed to return. His figures were excellent. His habit of staying when the return grew expensive was not.

travellers.name: Edren
travellers.summary: Was digging when it happened. Has not stopped.
hints: More hard stone than loose ground. My trowel complains before I do.
The cold settles low enough to numb my fingers through the cloth.

diaryPages.prose: More hard stone than loose ground. My trowel complains before I do.
The cold settles low enough to numb my fingers through the cloth.
The walls beneath the ice meet at worked corners. This was a room before it froze, though I cannot yet date either event.
The lead seams repeat at measured intervals and terminate beside worked sockets. Natural deposition is possible, but deliberate placement better fits the evidence.
Ruin: a constructed place whose use has ended or become unclear. Record the surviving work before assigning a story to the absent workers.
Write a place with construction over older construction. The lower floor establishes first use; repairs and additions above it show later occupation without requiring a clean beginning.

travellers.name: Isolde
travellers.summary: Taught the Art before there was anything left to write about. Still teaching, to nobody.
hints: The land rises until every line I rule looks level by comparison.
Stone and packed ground cover most of this place. Even the horizon feels written in it.

diaryPages.prose: The land rises until every line I rule looks level by comparison.
Stone and packed ground cover most of this place. Even the horizon feels written in it.
Your hand is the repeated motion behind the mark. A better tool can make that motion smaller or cleaner, but it cannot practise on your behalf.
Hush the air, settle your sleeve, then draw. If the line still trembles, the movement came from your hand and you can work on it.
Rough charcoal makes every correction visible. Learn to commit the stroke. Then use a brush, where pressure and angle let you revise the shape while you draw it.
Tovin closes a binding with excellent control and terrible judgement about when to stop. Fear steadies his hand. He remains annoyingly proud of the wrong half of that assessment.

travellers.name: Sela
travellers.summary: Was always leaving. This time it took.
hints: Enough water that I can choose the next crossing instead of rationing the last.
You can see for a very long way.
Plants grow thickly across much of the ground. That is a mercy.

diaryPages.prose: Enough water that I can choose the next crossing instead of rationing the last.
You can see for a very long way.
Plants grow thickly across much of the ground. That is a mercy.
Write somewhere the weather makes decisions for you. Pack for the forecast you wanted, then pack for the one that will actually turn up.
A pond is a small body of still water you can walk around. Check the bank before drinking. Check what is already drinking before choosing a bank.
Halloway is tending a banked fire somewhere warm. She said she would keep it alive until we arrived, so bring dry fuel and do not make her prove how long she can wait.

travellers.name: Auber
travellers.summary: Separates a thing from what carried it. Never calls what remains nothing.
hints: Water leaves a white mineral crust when it dries, and the next water carries the same sharp taste. Separation changes the carrier that follows.
Water gathers into distinct bodies. A mixture needs an edge before its layers can be compared.
Most of the water stands in broad, still bodies long enough for sediment to settle. Patience separates some things and merely postpones others.
Heat and cold take turns carrying different parts. Neither interval tells the whole composition.
Much of the ground reacts strongly to heat or water by changing colour, shape or state. Any vessel used here must resist the same reactions.
The workable matter keeps to narrow seams. Precision can spare the ground or simply make taking more efficient.
Vapour keeps the farther edge uncertain. What leaves the vessel remains part of the process even when nobody collects it.
Conditions change sharply from one interval to the next, enough to alter the mixture each time. Repetition is not purification by itself.

Brine is water carrying enough dissolved salt to taste sharp and leave crystals as it dries. Reduce it slowly. Scorched salt ruins the finish and the room smells dreadful.
Nessa asks what the extract does to a particular body at a particular dose. I tell her what was concentrated and what remains dissolved. Then she stops me tasting it, usually correctly.
Grimmond brings me ore with stone, water and occasionally half a support brace attached. I separate the useful fraction. He insists I label the residue by weight. He is right and graceless.
Oda needs an output whose concentration and carrier are exact enough to contain. If my pure fraction hides its remaining vapour, she sends it back with annotations sharp enough to cut glass.

travellers.name: Tovin
travellers.summary: Wrote worlds before you did. Knows what that costs.
hints: Even at its brightest, the world remains dark. The dark is not empty.
Fungal growth spreads without sunlight. It has made the dark its own.
Stone and packed earth dominate the world—floor, wall, ceiling, and the dust between.
Everything is close. I do not like it.
The water leaves a white seam wherever it withdraws.
Even the deepest hours never soften the cold.
No draft reaches the loose corner of this page.

Stone and packed earth dominate the world—floor, wall, ceiling, and the dust between.
Everything is close. I do not like it.

Even the deepest hours never soften the cold.
No draft reaches the loose corner of this page.
Every interval arrives exactly when the last one promised.
Drift is the change between one measured interval and the next when the world does not keep our expected pace. Record both clocks. I learned this after trusting only one.
Edren chose a cold world because the layers remain undisturbed. He will be delighted, underdressed, and unwilling to admit either fact.
The ground rises into high ridges and steep slopes. Isolde always chose stone she could see by, far from a flickering fire.

The fourth world yielded enough Essence to fund the next binding. I called that self-sustaining while stripping it. Blue mineral rain fell on empty ground. I still miss the sound, which is not an excuse.
I wrote a generous world and refused to bind it because I distrusted my motive. The page was lost unused. I can explain the caution clearly; that does not recover the world.
Some worlds contain a natural anchor where the old binding still catches. The page pulls taut near it. Mark the seam first; decide what to attach only after you know the return route.

cast.contribution: Trading Post: appraisal and rotating buy/sell stock

diaryPages.title: Where someone is

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Plants and animals gather in separate pockets. Something common in one pocket may be scarce in the next; transport changes the price even when the goods arrive unchanged.

diaryPages.title: A focus

diaryPages.title: Word of someone

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write one plentiful material and one scarce one. Repairs will show what people could replace, what they had to conserve, and what a trader might profitably bring next.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built

cast.name: Noll

cast.contribution: Recycler: previewed recovery from ordinary gear

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Hard stone and compacted ground keep sharp edges when they break. The pieces could be fitted together again after the whole fails.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Useful material is concentrated in a few narrow seams rather than spread across the ground. Separate pieces should be easy to recover.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Halloway repairs objects I would dismantle. When she says a piece can be mended, let her try. When she says it cannot, stop asking. She has already tried in her head three times.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write hard material in a few clear seams. I can separate a clean boundary, count what came out, and leave the rest intact. Scattered fragments take longer and encourage sloppy sorting.

cast.contribution: Blacksmith: foundational gear and reforging

diaryPages.title: Where someone is

diaryPages.prose: Give me heat and ground I can shape. I can carry tools, fuel and iron; I cannot carry a workable floor in my pockets.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: A few gold flecks will waste an afternoon. A continuous vein can be cut, weighed and worked. Follow the stone before celebrating the shine.

diaryPages.title: A line of study
diaryPages.prose: A brush needs a thin ferrule that grips an even bundle without cutting the fibres. Bring Isolde workable metal; I will test the seam and replace it if it slips.

cast.contribution: Survey Post: instruments, readings and field loadout

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: At its brightest, the horizon burns white enough to swallow my sighting line.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Sela took the north path with two days of food and enough confidence for four. If the path was wrong, she will have found a better one by now.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: I tried to sight across the slope and found the ground had stopped pretending to be gradual. A scarp: steep face, abrupt rise, no sensible route straight up.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Give me one fixed horizon, ridge or shoreline and I can measure the rest against it. Write that reference first; interpretation can wait until we have observations.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: A crystal cut in the stone repeats the same crooked horizon from every face. I checked the instrument twice. The distortion belongs to the cavern.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Tovin counted distance by the bindings needed to return. His figures were excellent. His habit of staying when the return grew expensive was not.

cast.name: Edren

cast.contribution: Reliquary: site records and interpreted finds

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: More hard stone than loose ground. My trowel complains before I do.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The cold settles low enough to numb my fingers through the cloth.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: The walls beneath the ice meet at worked corners. This was a room before it froze, though I cannot yet date either event.

diaryPages.title: A line of study
diaryPages.prose: The lead seams repeat at measured intervals and terminate beside worked sockets. Natural deposition is possible, but deliberate placement better fits the evidence.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Ruin: a constructed place whose use has ended or become unclear. Record the surviving work before assigning a story to the absent workers.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write a place with construction over older construction. The lower floor establishes first use; repairs and additions above it show later occupation without requiring a clean beginning.

cast.name: Isolde
cast.meetingContext: A precise hand teaching itself against stone and weather
cast.contribution: Scriptorium: hands, ink practice and writing study

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The land rises until every line I rule looks level by comparison.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Stone and packed ground cover most of this place. Even the horizon feels written in it.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Your hand is the repeated motion behind the mark. A better tool can make that motion smaller or cleaner, but it cannot practise on your behalf.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Hush the air, settle your sleeve, then draw. If the line still trembles, the movement came from your hand and you can work on it.

diaryPages.title: A line of study
diaryPages.prose: Rough charcoal makes every correction visible. Learn to commit the stroke. Then use a brush, where pressure and angle let you revise the shape while you draw it.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Tovin closes a binding with excellent control and terrible judgement about when to stop. Fear steadies his hand. He remains annoyingly proud of the wrong half of that assessment.

cast.name: Sela
cast.meetingContext: Connected routes, usable water and room to leave
cast.contribution: Wayfarer's Table: packing and fieldcraft

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Enough water that I can choose the next crossing instead of rationing the last.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: You can see for a very long way.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Plants grow thickly across much of the ground. That is a mercy.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write somewhere the weather makes decisions for you. Pack for the forecast you wanted, then pack for the one that will actually turn up.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: A pond is a small body of still water you can walk around. Check the bank before drinking. Check what is already drinking before choosing a bank.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Halloway is tending a banked fire somewhere warm. She said she would keep it alive until we arrived, so bring dry fuel and do not make her prove how long she can wait.

cast.name: Bryn
cast.meetingContext: A watched approach where standing first is a choice
cast.contribution: Formation knowledge for protecting exposed allies
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase for an exposed back-rank ally

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Close walls and bends block long views along nearly every path. I could watch one approach at a time here.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Hard stone covers much of the ground and does not yield under a loaded step. Good footing matters when somebody has to hold position.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air becomes unusually dense and heavy at its peak. Everyone breathes harder in it, including the person standing first.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: Watch the back rank. If an ally there can be reached before we can answer, protect that position first. Their strength is not the problem; our formation is.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write a narrow approach with two exits. I can hold the approach while everyone leaves through the second. If there is only one exit, we are not defending a route; we are sealing it.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: The camp had a guard post but no alarm within reach. Put a bell, line or loose stones beside the watch. Waking people should not require a speech.

cast.name: Orsa
cast.meetingContext: A sheltered gathering place with more than one exit
cast.contribution: Firepit stewardship and the later Tavern

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Thick plant growth and fresh animal traces fill nearly every usable patch of ground. Even a cleared place is occupied again by morning.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Close ridges and sheltered hollows divide the ground into small spaces with short views. Several still have more than one way out.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air remains almost completely still, and smoke rises straight upward. A fire could be placed without its smoke crossing every bedroll.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: A hive is a shared structure built and supplied by many animals returning to it. Admire from outside. Its residents have not mistaken your curiosity for an invitation.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Sela leaves early and marks the return route carefully. She dislikes settling down, not returning. Save her a dry seat and do not make a ceremony of it.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Vance reads a room by its repaired objects. He calls that trade knowledge because 'noticing everyone's broken kettle' sounds nosy. He is both useful and nosy.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: This camp's fire ring was rebuilt three times, each one smaller. Later travellers reused the shelter and changed it to fit. Leave dry kindling for the fourth group.

cast.name: Talin
cast.meetingContext: Hard, open ground where an opening can close while you think
cast.contribution: Techniques for answering heavily armoured foes
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase for genuinely armoured foes

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Hard ground breaks into rigid plates with clean edges. A blade or claw would glance away from the shallow angles.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Nothing here hides an approach. That does not make deciding when to meet it easier.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: At the brightest interval every edge separates from the surface behind it. A visible opening can still close while you consider it.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: Save the narrow point for armour an ordinary strike cannot pierce. Check the target, choose the seam, strike, recover. Do not waste precision on a target already open.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Dagg chooses ground where a rushed swing ruins the recovery. He will wait for the perfect moment. Remind him the rest of the party is still being attacked while he admires it.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Bryn moves immediately when someone else is exposed. When only she is at risk, she checks every exit twice. Plan for both habits; arguing with either one takes too long.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write one clear edge visible from a distance. Choose before you reach it: cross, stop or turn. A perfect answer made after the opening closes is still late.

cast.name: Nessa
cast.meetingContext: A living, reactive world where dose matters more than labels
cast.contribution: Apothecary: remedies and prepared coatings

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air carries a toxic trace that leaves a bitter taste after the first breath. Exposure begins before the smell becomes obvious.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Dense plant growth and abundant animal signs show that life thrives across this world. Where so much survives, some species may also tolerate its poisons.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: There is water to work with. That is not the same as water safe to drink, and neither fact tells me what it can carry.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Much of the exposed ground reacts to moisture by changing colour, venting or shifting. I need to test which reactions are dangerous.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: A thorn is a rigid point that breaks or irritates tissue on contact. Record where it entered, how deep, and what reaction follows. 'Cruel' is not a useful symptom.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write the same substance beside two different living things. Record dose, route, time and response for each. Do not label it remedy or poison until you can finish that sentence.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: The basin releases hot water carrying dissolved mineral. Test temperature, water and sediment separately before bottling any of it. One convenient pulse is three possible causes.

cast.name: Corrin
cast.meetingContext: Wet, living ground that tests every fastening through repetition
cast.contribution: Tannery: flexible protective gear

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Fresh growth returns quickly beside old cut and feeding marks. Replacement does not excuse taking, but it means useful material is being produced steadily.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Plant feeding marks, predator tracks and scavenger traces overlap in every patch. Several layers of the food chain are active here.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Strong winds keep broad leaves and flexible growth bending. Each returns and shows where the strain travelled.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Films, puddles and shallow crossings spread water across nearly the whole route. Leather fastenings would swell repeatedly here.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Chitin forms hard protective plates joined by flexible tissue. Copy the overlap, not just the plate. A guard that cannot bend is a box with ambitions.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: Write a wet place with constant movement. Fit one binding, use it for ten crossings, then inspect the swollen edge and repeated rub points. The bench cannot tell you where a body will complain.

cast.name: Dagg
cast.meetingContext: Hard ground, large changes and enough quiet to prepare
cast.contribution: Techniques built around completing recovery
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase for completed recovery

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The ground is hard and unyielding under every step. Good. An honest consequence can be prepared for.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Steep climbs and drops interrupt most routes, and many landings cannot be seen from above. A hurried step will not make the landing arrive sooner.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Conditions swing from long quiet periods to sudden, extreme changes. Both extremes demand preparation.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Strong gusts move through the world, then briefly fall still. Swinging is not different because the weapon has a name.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: Recovery ends when your feet are set and you can choose the next action. Decide that action before the swing. Heavy weapons are excellent at making hesitation visible.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Halloway listens after every hammer strike and adjusts to the metal. Opponents adjust back. That is why I left the forge—and why she says I am wasting a perfectly good hammer arm.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Talin takes the first usable opening. I wait for one worth the recovery. If we disagree during the fight, somebody else pays for the delay, so settle the signal beforehand.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing

cast.name: Rook
cast.meetingContext: A visible approach where distance can remain a warning
cast.contribution: Reach techniques and legible boundaries
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase for a foe unable to reach the user

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The land is extremely open, with an unobstructed view almost to the horizon. An approaching creature would be visible from far away.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The ground offers no rise high enough to erase what is coming. Warning is possible here.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Most water gathers in broad, still lakes and pools rather than flowing channels. Every crossing becomes a deliberate route around or through them.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Grass tips remain still enough to show the smallest disturbance. Distance speaks before the person crossing it does.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase

diaryPages.title: Word of someone

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing

cast.name: Lys
cast.meetingContext: Layered ruins whose contradictory records remain readable
cast.contribution: Library stewardship, search and cross-reference

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Ruined walls, foundations and worked stone have been broken and rebuilt across the ground. Several periods of construction remain visible.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Light, weather and other world changes return on a highly predictable schedule. That makes one interval easy to compare with the next.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The light never leaves completely. Even an unfinished record remains readable, which is not the same as remaining understood.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air is so still that a loose page remains open to the same line. Any movement on the page can be attributed to something nearby.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Echo: a returned sound altered by distance, delay and the surfaces it crossed. Catalogue the original call separately; otherwise the room gets credited as co-author.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Edren indexes each fragment by its layer. I index his notes by revision. Cross-reference both or you will know where an object was found but not when he stopped being wrong about it.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Isolde identifies a hand by pressure, spacing and omitted strokes. She objects to my catalogue of her objections. I have filed this under 'recurring, well-supported.'

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built

cast.name: Bracken
cast.meetingContext: Hard ground and changing temperatures that expose every seam
cast.contribution: Armoury: advanced defensive profiles

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: A tool skates before it bites. Hardness protects the surface by sending the effort back through the hand.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: At the hot interval every fastening asks for more room. Armour that cannot change has chosen where it will split.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Cold draws the same joints tight. Protection becomes a promise the material may no longer be able to keep.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Steep ledges and sloping routes repeatedly tilt the body away from level ground. Armour fitted only for level footing would catch and shift here.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air is dense enough to press against every seam and gap. The body underneath will not call a weak join negligible.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Bone carries load without being solid all the way through. Copy the thick supports and the lighter spaces between them. Do not copy the fracture.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Halloway can make metal hold almost any shape. I make her put it on and climb stairs before calling the shape useful. She grumbles; the armour improves.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Corrin checks every place armour rubs or catches. I check where the blow lands. Between us, the wearer may survive and still want to wear the thing again.

cast.name: Fen
cast.meetingContext: Open distance, moving air and repeatable intervals
cast.contribution: Bowyer: advanced ranged construction

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The land is extremely open, with almost no nearby obstruction between one position and the horizon. A shot could travel a long way before striking anything.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: A long string bows with the moving air even while both ends insist it is straight.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Plants and other living growth gather in a few separated stands, leaving broad clear gaps between them. Those gaps provide long, unobstructed lines.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Water is concentrated in a few broad bodies instead of spread through many channels and puddles. Their edges can be planned around from a distance.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Light, wind and other world changes return on a predictable schedule. Repeating a shot under the same interval could produce a useful comparison.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Silk spreads tension along one continuous thread. Light, strong, honest about a bad knot. Good string material if kept dry.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Rook uses distance to warn. I use it to land a shot. We mark which line is which before I string anything. Saves arguments. Occasionally saves Rook.

cast.name: Wren
cast.meetingContext: A world opening another route before the first closes
cast.contribution: Tempo techniques for crowded encounters
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase for encounters with at least three foes

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The ground is open enough to keep several routes in sight at once. Keep seeing the others after you decide which one to take.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Strong, shifting winds begin a new movement before the last has finished. A plan may do the same if its exits remain honest.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Shallow water interrupts nearly every route. None is impossible; all charge attention.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Dense growth quickly fills cleared ground behind each passage. Mobility is the work of leaving room in a place that keeps using it.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The quiet and the rush demand different routes through the same ground. Remembering only the dramatic one is how exits disappear.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: Three foes: count which exits they close, spot the gap, move now. Do not solve three fights when one open route solves the position.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Sela leaves excellent route notes. I leave several routes open and forget to label any of them. Follow hers if you are arriving after me.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Dagg wants one committed strike with a planned recovery. I want two exits and permission to change my mind. We work well together when he stops calling the second exit cowardice.

cast.name: Kestrel
cast.meetingContext: A rich ecology whose tracks defeat the convenient story
cast.contribution: Bestiary practice and first-observation techniques
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase for an unrecorded species

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Fresh growth beneath older feeding marks proves the account begins before the animal I came to find.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Too many tracks use this ground for one creature to explain it. Good evidence first defeats the convenient story.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Grazing crosses pursuit, scavenging crosses both, and smaller traces live inside the margins. A body is never the whole system.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Close ridges, walls and bends hide what lies beyond them. Absence past the fold is not proof of departure.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Fine disturbance stays visible at range. Observation becomes easier; interpretation does not.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: Unrecorded species: observe before assuming the familiar response. Note posture, range and first action. Surviving the introduction is useful data for both parties.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Corrin uses every workable part of a carcass. I record what took it, what fed afterward and whether collecting the remains would interrupt either. She waits for the answer.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Fen reads a moving animal across open distance. I read the tracks after it leaves. His shots are clean; the scavenger evidence afterward rarely is.

cast.name: Maud
cast.meetingContext: Materials and terrain that make fit a moving measurement
cast.contribution: Weaponsmith and an earned polearm fitting pattern

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Much of the ground is hard enough to hold a sharp edge instead of bending or crumbling. Useful, if the edge suits the motion asked of it.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Another part bends and keeps the new shape. Adjustment is a material property before it is a virtue.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Steep climbs, drops and ledges change posture along nearly every route. The same weapon reach feels long on one ledge and short on the next.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air is almost completely still, and loose measures remain where they are placed. That lets me separate a weapon's balance from interference by wind.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The same light and weather conditions return at a highly predictable time. I can test each alteration under matching conditions.

diaryPages.title: A pattern
diaryPages.prose: Fit the weapon to a motion the wielder can repeat. Mark grip width, reach, recovery clearance and every allowance. A heroic pose is not a measurement.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Halloway asks the material whether a change will hold. I hand the result to a wielder and ask whether it should. Her answer is usually prettier. Mine is usually louder.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Bracken spreads incoming force across armour. I adjust the weapon's leverage before that force arrives. If either of us ignores comfort, the user compensates and ruins both calculations.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Dagg tests whether the wielder can recover from the swing a weapon encourages. I shortened the grip. He came back with three objections instead of seven. Progress.

cast.name: Marrick
cast.meetingContext: Shared ground where a routine can be tested by the person it forgot
cast.contribution: Mature formation support
cast.diaryReward: a gambit phrase triggered when any ally is below full health

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The ground is hard and level enough to hold firm beneath several sets of feet. A shared instruction can begin here without becoming shared judgement.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: There is room to stand together and still see the edges. Too much room dissolves the signal; too little makes agreement irrelevant.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Strong wind reaches every position across the whole line. Equal exposure does not mean equal effort, no matter how neatly the positions are counted.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Temperature stays within a narrow range from the coldest interval to the warmest. That makes fatigue easier to compare across every position.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Light, weather and other world changes return on a highly predictable schedule. Everyone can practise the same routine against the same timing.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: There is water along the route. No one person must carry enough for everyone, which is how a provision becomes part of the formation.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: Write the response for any ally below the health threshold, not a favoured name. Nearest member opens space; rear member covers; injured member chooses the exit.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Bryn rescues the person my formation failed to protect. I am revising the formation. She is revising my definition of 'unexpected.' Both tasks are overdue.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Rook's boundary is readable from the approach. Mine was readable only to trained people already inside it. I have redrawn every marker and added an outside-facing signal.

diaryPages.title: An account
diaryPages.prose: Report: the formation held and every assigned position returned. Omission: two porters were never assigned positions and were counted with the supplies. Revision: no person enters the next exercise as cargo.

cast.name: Sabine
cast.meetingContext: An ecology with room to approach, refuse and return
cast.contribution: Menagerie: voluntary trust, housing and assignment

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: New shoots bitten down at dusk grow above the old cut by morning. Plant matter is being produced quickly enough to support repeated feeding.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Every shelter is occupied, and fresh tracks stop at the entrances before turning away. More creatures live here than one keeper could gather.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Small grazers crowd the new growth. Larger tracks circle them, and scavengers follow what the hunt leaves behind. Feed one creature here and three others change their route.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The same hollows are pressed flat each night while nearby ground goes untouched. Return often enough and absence becomes part of the pattern.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Hoofprints, paws and dragging tails reach the water by different banks. No creature has to pass another's shelter to drink.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: There is open ground enough to approach and cover near enough to refuse. I could work here without making nearness the only safe choice.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The same calls begin at the same interval, and the same paths fill soon after. They can learn when I return; that does not mean they must come.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Coral is a shared structure built by many tiny animals that remain very much alive and very bad at introductions. Observe the colony; do not pry off a souvenir.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Kestrel reads tracks made before an animal noticed us. I watch what changes after it learns my routine. Between us, the animal is usually several observations ahead.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Marrick builds routines that still work when people panic. I asked where an animal may stand if it refuses the assigned position. He has been revising the diagram ever since.

cast.name: Grimmond
cast.meetingContext: Rich seams under load, poor light and thinner breath
cast.contribution: Deep Works: depth sounding and discovered-sign records

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Even the brightest interval leaves the lowest face unreadable. Value does not make a place consent to inspection.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Stone and packed earth make up nearly all of this place. The ledger may call the material between seams waste; the roof disagrees.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The richest matter keeps to a narrow seam. Following it is easy. Knowing where to stop is the work.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Hard stone surrounds each seam and carries the weight above it. Removal has already begun before the valuable piece moves.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Every route closes behind another wall. Extraction makes an opening and assigns its absence somewhere else.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Deep drops, high faces and steep shafts divide the ground vertically. Every route carries weight above it and open space below.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Breath thins before stone yields. A body is the first support the plan spends.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Mercury runs to the lowest gap and joins pools through cracks you missed. Build the tray before opening the seam. Chasing it afterward is expensive and poisonous.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Edren wants every layer left readable. I need to know which layer holds the roof. We mark the record, photograph the face, then argue about whether I may remove it.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Grimmond brings me ore with stone, water and occasionally half a support brace attached. I separate the useful fraction. He insists I label the residue by weight. He is right and graceless.

diaryPages.title: An account
diaryPages.prose: Ore yield: as estimated. Empty chamber: as estimated. Supports requested: denied because the chamber was listed as a by-product. The roof has not read the ledger.

cast.name: Oda
cast.meetingContext: Unlike forces held near enough for their routes to be followed
cast.contribution: Channelworks and Emanation Housing

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Much of the ground is hard enough to keep its shape under force. A housing begins with what refuses to travel.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Other parts of the ground react to pressure by shifting, venting or changing shape. Calling that instability does not explain the route.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The world is enclosed by close walls and narrow passages. Sounds echo nearby instead of carrying into the distance.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Still air leaves the effect where it was released. At last the instrument cannot blame the weather.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: A harmful trace remains after the visible source is gone. Invisible continuation is still part of the discharge.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Heat gathers at every join intended to hold it. The housing reports its design through the first place it hurts.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Light persists between bright intervals. A carrier can continue after its dramatic moment has passed.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Light, weather and other world changes return on a highly predictable schedule. Repeating a test under the same interval can distinguish containment from luck.

diaryPages.title: A schematic
diaryPages.prose: Housing requirements: defined inlet, constrained route, rated stop and visible failure point. The force remains hazardous. The housing makes its path inspectable.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Fen stores work in a drawn string and releases it along a visible carrier. My carrier may be heat, light or caustic charge. It must be equally traceable, though Fen objects to my use of 'equally.'

cast.name: Auber
cast.meetingContext: Water, mineral, heat and residue separating at different rates
cast.contribution: Distillery: crystallising and attuning prepared cores

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Water leaves a white mineral crust when it dries, and the next water carries the same sharp taste. Separation changes the carrier that follows.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Water gathers into distinct bodies. A mixture needs an edge before its layers can be compared.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Most of the water stands in broad, still bodies long enough for sediment to settle. Patience separates some things and merely postpones others.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Heat and cold take turns carrying different parts. Neither interval tells the whole composition.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Much of the ground reacts strongly to heat or water by changing colour, shape or state. Any vessel used here must resist the same reactions.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The workable matter keeps to narrow seams. Precision can spare the ground or simply make taking more efficient.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Vapour keeps the farther edge uncertain. What leaves the vessel remains part of the process even when nobody collects it.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Conditions change sharply from one interval to the next, enough to alter the mixture each time. Repetition is not purification by itself.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Brine is water carrying enough dissolved salt to taste sharp and leave crystals as it dries. Reduce it slowly. Scorched salt ruins the finish and the room smells dreadful.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Nessa asks what the extract does to a particular body at a particular dose. I tell her what was concentrated and what remains dissolved. Then she stops me tasting it, usually correctly.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Grimmond brings me ore with stone, water and occasionally half a support brace attached. I separate the useful fraction. He insists I label the residue by weight. He is right and graceless.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Oda needs an output whose concentration and carrier are exact enough to contain. If my pure fraction hides its remaining vapour, she sends it back with annotations sharp enough to cut glass.

cast.name: Ashe
cast.meetingContext: Warning stones around a body already carrying visible force
cast.contribution: Active-release combat knowledge
cast.diaryReward: an active-emanation gambit phrase and the Spent Emanation Housing site lead

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Heat rises through my feet before the sky changes. The body notices direction even when the instrument reports only amount.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The world swings sharply between heat and cold. My joints notice the change before the scale finishes moving.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Light remains without a visible sky-source. Absence of a lamp does not make the sensation imaginary.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The ground reacts to pressure by shifting, cracking or changing shape instead of merely holding it. I recognise the reply because mine is also mistaken for obedience.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The harmful trace stays in the breath after its cause disappears. Danger does not owe anyone a dramatic entrance.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The air brings the effect from several directions. A body cannot face every source, but it can name what that costs.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Growth continues beneath conditions called hostile. Survival proves capacity, not comfort.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Heat, light, wind and other conditions swing between mild and extreme states. Even a predictable return to the extreme is a burden on the body.

diaryPages.title: A gambit phrase
diaryPages.prose: If a foe is emanating, the release is already happening around the visible attack. Ground or interrupt that active force first. The body producing it is not the whole hazard.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Oda asks where a failed housing sends the force. I ask who is standing in that path and whether they agreed to be there. We need both answers before a test.

diaryPages.title: An account
diaryPages.prose: I warned them the release was building. They called me sensitive. After I absorbed it, they called me strong. I needed them to move the first time.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: The housing is empty. The surrounding stone is still hot and my hands are tingling. The device finished releasing; this place has not finished receiving it.

cast.name: Tovin
cast.meetingContext: A dark, enclosed world whose exact timing cannot cure desire
cast.contribution: Anchorage: permanent-realm portfolio and return work
cast.diaryReward: Drift focus and the Atlas Seam site lead

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Even at its brightest, the world remains dark. The dark is not empty.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Fungal growth spreads without sunlight. It has made the dark its own.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Stone and packed earth dominate the world—floor, wall, ceiling, and the dust between.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Everything is close. I do not like it.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The water leaves a white seam wherever it withdraws.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Even the deepest hours never soften the cold.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: No draft reaches the loose corner of this page.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Every interval arrives exactly when the last one promised.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: Drift is the change between one measured interval and the next when the world does not keep our expected pace. Record both clocks. I learned this after trusting only one.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Edren chose a cold world because the layers remain undisturbed. He will be delighted, underdressed, and unwilling to admit either fact.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The ground rises into high ridges and steep slopes. Isolde always chose stone she could see by, far from a flickering fire.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: The fourth world yielded enough Essence to fund the next binding. I called that self-sustaining while stripping it. Blue mineral rain fell on empty ground. I still miss the sound, which is not an excuse.

diaryPages.title: A world worth writing
diaryPages.prose: I wrote a generous world and refused to bind it because I distrusted my motive. The page was lost unused. I can explain the caution clearly; that does not recover the world.

diaryPages.title: Somewhere built
diaryPages.prose: Some worlds contain a natural anchor where the old binding still catches. The page pulls taut near it. Mark the seam first; decide what to attach only after you know the return route.

cast.name: Perren
cast.meetingContext: Ruined ritual fragments that support more than one arrangement
cast.contribution: Mirror focus and interpretive endgame story
cast.diaryReward: Mirror focus. Perren's pages have no canonical chronology

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Bright light and deep shadow are both strong here, often side by side. They taught that conflict reveals the truer source; it may only reveal who selected the frame.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Heat and cold press into the same interval. A forced choice between them would make either answer feel discovered.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Growth and suppression are both active. The bare patch is evidence of relation, not proof that one side was always barren.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Ruins and repeatedly broken structures cover the ground. One history has been built directly over another.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Close walls and narrow corridors restrict both sight and travel. The next choice can resemble the only one once the corridor is built.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Worked matter is spread evenly. Any chosen sample can represent the whole if no one asks who chose it.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Haze obscures distant ground long before nearby objects disappear. Distance removes context before it removes the object.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The same interval returns at a regular, predictable time. Repetition can teach expectation and then present fulfilment as revelation.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Retreating water leaves a bright white mineral line along every bank. It looks inevitable after it appears; the water remembers otherwise.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: A mirror offers exactness after reversing the image and cutting away everything beyond its edge. Useful, therefore, as an accusation against the frame—not as its witness.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Lys preserves contradictory accounts without forcing one to disappear. I once named that cowardice. The doctrine had trained me to fear any archive in which its victory was not inevitable.

diaryPages.title: A turn
diaryPages.prose: There is no sentence I can underline and call the moment belief became departure. I merely stopped discarding the questions the lesson announced it had already answered.

cast.name: Nine
cast.meetingContext: A verified arrangement revised by the person living with it now
cast.contribution: Dream focus and the continuity arc

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: No interval arrives when the last one taught me to expect it. I can record surprise without treating it as failure.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The world changes dramatically from one interval to the next. Both accounts belong to the person who wrote them.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: A little light persists without naming its source. Continuity does not require a complete origin.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Temperature stays within a narrow range even while other conditions change. I can use that stable range as a reference without calling it the whole world.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: Water reaches nearly every route and never the same point twice. Repetition may preserve a relation without preserving a shape.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The same material is spread widely and evenly while the surface changes. Familiarity can be verified without pretending it is recollection.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: The land is neither cramped nor completely open; a clear horizon remains within visible bounds. I can use it to check my place without asking it to become an escape.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: New growth stands beside what the last interval damaged. The later life is not a repair pretending nothing happened.

diaryPages.title: Where someone is
diaryPages.prose: A loose marker remains where I placed it. I trust the choice again when I see it, even if I cannot recover making it.

diaryPages.title: A focus
diaryPages.prose: A dream joins things without proving they once happened together. It can make a possibility inhabitable without turning it into recovered fact.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Isolde reads discipline in the pressure of a hand. She does not claim the pressure tells her who the hand truly was. This is why I let her teach me.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Ashe is treated as evidence of a force larger than them. We agree that being evidence does not surrender authorship of what happens next.

diaryPages.title: Word of someone
diaryPages.prose: Tovin binds a world so return remains possible. I bind a marker to a choice for the same reason: return, not restoration.

stations.blurb: Everything anybody wrote down about where they went.

stations.blurb: Reforge what you carry into something better.

stations.blurb: Fit flexible living material into protection and carrying work.

stations.name: The Bowyer
stations.blurb: Fit far-reaching physical weapons without an ammunition inventory.
stations.purpose: all nonmagical ranged weapon families; no ammunition inventory.
stations.buildBlurb: Fen needs straight stock, patient fibres and enough resin to make every draw hold.

stations.name: The Armoury
stations.blurb: Rebuild one familiar protective piece around a deliberate defensive Construction.
stations.purpose: advanced protective gear and deliberate rigid/insulated/balanced defensive profiles.
stations.buildBlurb: Bracken needs iron, clay and copper enough to rebuild protection without pretending its old shape was sacred.

stations.name: The Weaponsmith
stations.blurb: Fit advanced physical weapons to repeatable motion, reach and consequence.
stations.purpose: advanced nonmagical melee weapons fitted to repeatable motion, reach and consequence.
stations.buildBlurb: Maud needs enough iron and copper to test the alteration, and a little gold for the measures that must not drift.

stations.name: The Scriptorium
stations.blurb: Learn to write smaller, and to say more with less.
stations.purpose: writing hands, inks, compounds and page grammar—not Library storage.
stations.buildBlurb: Isolde needs a room with good light and a table that doesn't rock. She is very specific about the table.

stations.name: The Firepit
stations.blurb: Somewhere for the people you bring home.
stations.purpose: initially seats recruited people; later becomes the visitor/resting social place.

stations.name: The Bestiary
stations.blurb: Everything you have met out there, and how the one you met compared.

stations.name: The Survey Post
stations.blurb: Instruments for reading a world you are standing in.
stations.purpose: field instruments, survey loadout and progressively more exact analysis.
stations.buildBlurb: Mara wants somewhere flat, out of the wind, with a clear line to the horizon. She has been carrying the lenses this whole time.

stations.name: The Apothecary
stations.blurb: Remedies and preparations made from what the worlds grew.
stations.purpose: consumable remedies, coatings and preparations from world-grown inputs. Station tier controls preparation permission, not recipe discovery. Finding/inferencing a higher recipe records it normally and may show its name/requirements, but preparation remains blocked by the named bench. Legacy saves retain every already-known/preparable recipe through an explicit grandfathered entitlement.
stations.buildBlurb: Nessa needs a clean room, vessels that can take heat, and shelves for what the worlds grew. Raising it makes Lesser Salve available immediately.

stations.name: The Reliquary
stations.blurb: Edren's record of where people once stood, and what they left behind.
stations.purpose: discovered sites, field interpretation, earlier habitation and honest recovered-site yield.
stations.buildBlurb: Edren needs shelves for fragments, broad tables for plans, and somewhere every recovered thing can keep its place.

stations.name: The Wayfarer's Table
stations.blurb: Field notes and packing methods for bringing home more of what the worlds grow.
stations.purpose: passive shared fieldcraft, packing, organic yield and visible-flora recognition. It is not a route planner, departure hub, world graph, Party screen or supplies shop.
stations.buildBlurb: Sela wants one broad table for field guides, samples and careful packing—not a counter, and not somewhere she is expected to stay.

stations.name: The Distillery
stations.blurb: Attune Essence Crystals through world-made samples.
stations.purpose: crystallise Essence and create authored emanation cores; not ordinary potion making.
stations.buildBlurb: Auber needs vessels that make every fraction visible, and shelves where no residue is mistaken for nothing.

stations.name: The Channelworks
stations.blurb: Oda gives concentrated emanations a route and a boundary.
stations.purpose: all magical weapons, from contained cores to projected emanation housings.
stations.buildBlurb: Oda needs a bench where a live core can be contained before it is given reach.

stations.name: The Anchorage
stations.blurb: Worlds rebound into the Atlas, kept where they can be reached again.
stations.purpose: all three anchoring routes plus the complete realm portfolio, settlement, Work/People assignments and Deliveries. Those are one baseline system, not late tabs withheld as an upgrade.
stations.buildBlurb: Tovin needs a quiet room for the Atlas and a frame stout enough to hold open a way that should have closed.

researchNodes.name: Noticing 10%
researchNodes.blurb: The last moment anything can be done.

researchNodes.name: Reasoning upward
researchNodes.blurb: Conditions that trigger on plenty rather than on lack.

researchNodes.name: Instructing a skill
researchNodes.blurb: Rules that reach for something better than a swing.

researchNodes.name: Instructing retreat
researchNodes.blurb: Knowing when to stop is a rule like any other.

researchNodes.name: A longer instruction
researchNodes.blurb: One more rule your companion will follow.

researchNodes.name: A longer instruction, again
researchNodes.blurb: And one more after that.

researchNodes.name: Write your own hand
researchNodes.blurb: Your own rules, followed without you. The hardest thing to teach.

researchNodes.name: Study: growth
researchNodes.blurb: Copper-green bloom over everything it touches.

researchNodes.name: Study: permanence
researchNodes.blurb: Something that shouldn't be buried, buried anyway.

researchNodes.name: Shelving
researchNodes.blurb: Room at home for more of what you drag back.

researchNodes.name: Shelving, deeper
researchNodes.blurb: More still.

researchNodes.name: Shelving, to the rafters
researchNodes.blurb: There is no more wall.

researchNodes.name: Satchel stitching
researchNodes.blurb: Carry more out of a world before you have to choose.

researchNodes.name: Satchel, reinforced
researchNodes.blurb: It holds. Mostly.

researchNodes.name: Deepen the spring
researchNodes.blurb: More essence waiting each time you come home.

researchNodes.name: Second pass
researchNodes.blurb: Practice the ordinary conversion until each Raw Essence yields three instead of two.

researchNodes.name: Continuous settling
researchNodes.blurb: Automatically refine only the Raw retained by each new expedition outcome.

researchNodes.name: The trade
researchNodes.blurb: A world that crawls with things holds together longer. Learn to ask for that on purpose.

researchNodes.name: Foul weather
researchNodes.blurb: Let the sky do the work.

researchNodes.name: Unsettled ground
researchNodes.blurb: The most stability the trade can buy, and the ground you have to cross for it.

researchNodes.name: Fewer, worse
researchNodes.blurb: Thin them out, and make what remains a problem.

researchNodes.name: Bad ground
researchNodes.blurb: What grows here is wrong, and it spreads.

researchNodes.name: Bad air
researchNodes.blurb: It costs you a little every turn you stay.

researchNodes.name: Peace
researchNodes.blurb: The trade run backwards: a quiet world, and less of it. For somewhere you mean to keep.

researchNodes.name: Shelving, wall to wall
researchNodes.blurb: Every wall is shelf now. You stopped noticing when.

researchNodes.name: A second room
researchNodes.blurb: The room next door was never used for anything else anyway.

researchNodes.name: The undercroft
researchNodes.blurb: Cold, dry, and further down than you remembered digging.

researchNodes.name: The undercroft, extended
researchNodes.blurb: It goes back further than the house above it.

researchNodes.name: A hall for it
researchNodes.blurb: You could lose something in here and find it again years later.

researchNodes.name: More than you can carry
researchNodes.blurb: There is no longer a question of whether to keep a thing.

researchNodes.name: Satchel, deepened
researchNodes.blurb: Deeper than it looks, which was the point.

researchNodes.name: A second strap
researchNodes.blurb: Across the other shoulder. Heavier, and worth it.

researchNodes.name: Panniers
researchNodes.blurb: Slung either side. You walk differently now.

researchNodes.name: A brush
researchNodes.blurb: A copper ferrule holds fibre bristles to a timber handle. Half the room, and Isolde will not stop calling it a beginning.

researchNodes.name: A table that doesn't rock
researchNodes.blurb: Isolde's first condition, and she was right about it. Raises the Scriptorium.

researchNodes.name: Ink Mixing
researchNodes.blurb: Prepare deliberate liquid inks without changing the hand that lays them down.

researchNodes.name: Compound Assembly
researchNodes.blurb: Assemble learned Sigils without confusing their meaning with their shape.

researchNodes.name: Chaining
researchNodes.blurb: Joining one statement to another, so a world can have two kinds of land in it.

researchNodes.name: A ruling frame
researchNodes.blurb: Lines true enough to write a hair's width between them. Raises the Scriptorium again.

researchNodes.name: A fountain pen
researchNodes.blurb: A nib ground to nothing and a barrel that holds its ink. Everything, in a quarter of the room.

researchNodes.name: Starlight
researchNodes.blurb: The faintest mark that a world has a sky at all.

researchNodes.name: Weather
researchNodes.blurb: Mist, and the river it becomes.

researchNodes.name: Rivers
researchNodes.blurb: Water that goes somewhere.

researchNodes.name: Wetland
researchNodes.blurb: Ground that never decides whether it is water.

researchNodes.name: Springs
researchNodes.blurb: Water arriving from underneath, hot.

researchNodes.name: Thin air
researchNodes.blurb: Air that is barely there. Nothing else thins a sky.

researchNodes.name: Burning
researchNodes.blurb: Fire in a landscape, and what it takes with it.

researchNodes.name: The vent
researchNodes.blurb: Rock that has not finished moving.

researchNodes.name: The melt
researchNodes.blurb: Stone as a liquid.

researchNodes.name: Salt
researchNodes.blurb: What is left where water was, and what it does to life.

researchNodes.name: Brimstone
researchNodes.blurb: The yellow rock, and the air around it.

researchNodes.name: Silt
researchNodes.blurb: Ground sorted fine and washed through.

researchNodes.name: Decay
researchNodes.blurb: What happens after. It is not nothing.

researchNodes.name: Mycology
researchNodes.blurb: What grows where there is no sun to grow by.

researchNodes.name: The swarm
researchNodes.blurb: Small things, and a great many of them.

researchNodes.name: The foul air
researchNodes.blurb: Air that does not want you in it.

researchNodes.name: The pull
researchNodes.blurb: A world that rises and falls to something.

researchNodes.name: Clockwork
researchNodes.blurb: Somebody built a thing that keeps time, and it runs still.

researchNodes.name: Lattice
researchNodes.blurb: Stone that grew rather than settled, and holds a light without being lit.

researchNodes.name: Sunglass
researchNodes.blurb: Smoked quartz in a copper ring. You can look at a sky and put a number to it.

researchNodes.name: Level
researchNodes.blurb: A bubble in a tube of oil, in a timber frame. How much of this country is uphill.

researchNodes.name: Thermoscope
researchNodes.blurb: Mercury in a sealed stem. It reads the cold as readily as the heat, which is the hard part.

researchNodes.name: Hygrometer
researchNodes.blurb: A hair under tension, and a silver needle. It measures how much water a world will actually give you.

researchNodes.name: Loupe
researchNodes.blurb: Close work. What the ground is made of, seen properly rather than guessed at from the colour.

researchNodes.name: Vivometer
researchNodes.blurb: Resin, ichor and a lens. It answers the only question that matters about a world: what does it feed.

researchNodes.name: Barometer
researchNodes.blurb: A column of mercury against a silvered scale. Air has a weight, and the weight tells you the rest.

researchNodes.name: Chronometer
researchNodes.blurb: Adamant escapement, silver train. **Reading time is the hardest thing to learn**, so it is the last.

researchNodes.name: Ground and true
researchNodes.blurb: Flat glass, honestly worked. The page starts giving you numbers — for the subjects you have been out and measured, and no others.

researchNodes.name: Silvered back
researchNodes.blurb: Which of the things you wrote did what, secondaries included. The page stops being a list and starts being an argument.

researchNodes.name: The fine scale
researchNodes.blurb: Greed on one side of the beam and contradiction on the other. You can finally see which of the two is eating your world.

researchNodes.name: The long glass
researchNodes.blurb: What a world will grow, before it has grown it. The last thing a page can be made to say.

combatTechniques.name: Ambush
combatTechniques.blurb: The fight starts with your turn.
combatTechniques.effect: In an eligible opening, make one shared free direct attack before your first normal-cost action.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Blur
combatTechniques.blurb: Two whole turns, once, when it matters.
combatTechniques.effect: Once per encounter, take two ordinary actions without spending this action; cannot combine with Quicken this turn.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Brace
combatTechniques.blurb: You take the next one properly.
combatTechniques.effect: Reduce direct damage by 35% through the next hostile action slot that damages you.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Conceal
combatTechniques.blurb: Not there, for a moment.
combatTechniques.effect: Through next round, prevent direct targeting while another legal target exists; attacking or intervening reveals you.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Draw Off
combatTechniques.blurb: Make yourself the obvious problem.
combatTechniques.effect: Choose one foe; while Draw Off lasts, it targets you whenever legally able.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Emanation Strike
combatTechniques.blurb: Strike through a ward with a searing emanation.
combatTechniques.effect: Make a 9-power Heat, Caustic or Light attack, carrying Burn 4×2, Poison 2×4 or Dazzle 0×2.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Envenom
combatTechniques.blurb: Properly coated, for a while.
combatTechniques.effect: Arm your next 3 landed physical-weapon hits with Poison 2×3; misses spend no charge.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Fall Back
combatTechniques.blurb: Change where you're standing, and still get your turn.
combatTechniques.effect: As zero-turn setup, change Front↔Back and keep your ordinary action; this ends Bracing Stance.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Finish
combatTechniques.blurb: It was nearly over.
combatTechniques.effect: Strike one foe at full power below the shown HP threshold, or one-third power above it.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: First Strike
combatTechniques.blurb: Before it has decided anything.
combatTechniques.effect: As your first normal-cost action, attack for +4 raw damage without allowing retaliation.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Flense
combatTechniques.blurb: Open it, and keep it open.
combatTechniques.effect: Apply 3 Bleed ticks at 9% of covering insulation, rounded to at least 1 damage per tick.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Ground
combatTechniques.blurb: Receive the next emanation meant for somebody else.
combatTechniques.effect: Receive the next emanation meant for somebody else.
combatTechniques.availability: Inherent to Ashe

combatTechniques.name: Interpose
combatTechniques.blurb: Not them.
combatTechniques.effect: Receive the next legal hit meant for an ally, then the effect ends.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Mend
combatTechniques.blurb: Close what's open. Briefly.
combatTechniques.effect: Close what's open. Briefly.
combatTechniques.availability: Inherent to Quill

combatTechniques.name: Overbear
combatTechniques.blurb: Everything you have, and you're out of position after.
combatTechniques.effect: Make a heavy Crush attack now, then skip your next personal turn.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Pry
combatTechniques.blurb: Find the gap and lever it open.
combatTechniques.effect: Make a lower-power Pierce attack that ignores armour.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Quench
combatTechniques.blurb: Remove one burn, poison or dazzle.
combatTechniques.effect: Choose one ally and remove one selected Burn, Poison or Dazzle; Bleed and unchosen conditions remain.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Quicken
combatTechniques.blurb: Twice now, nothing next.
combatTechniques.effect: As zero-turn setup, take two ordinary actions now, then skip your next personal turn; cannot combine with Blur.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Read
combatTechniques.blurb: Take it in properly. You'll know it again.
combatTechniques.effect: Take it in properly. You'll know it again.
combatTechniques.availability: Inherent to Quill

combatTechniques.name: Shatter
combatTechniques.blurb: What it was wearing is not what it is wearing now.
combatTechniques.effect: Strike one foe and permanently reduce its armour for this encounter, to a minimum of 0.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Sidestep
combatTechniques.blurb: That one misses.
combatTechniques.effect: The next otherwise legal attack against you misses; its affliction also fails.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Sight
combatTechniques.blurb: Look at it properly.
combatTechniques.effect: Look at it properly.
combatTechniques.availability: Inherent to Binder

combatTechniques.name: Snuff
combatTechniques.blurb: Put out whatever it's giving off.
combatTechniques.effect: Suppress one foe's active emanation through its next 2 complete hostile turns.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

combatTechniques.name: Unbind
combatTechniques.blurb: Pull at the seam holding a thing together.
combatTechniques.effect: Pull at the seam holding a thing together.
combatTechniques.availability: Inherent to Binder

combatTechniques.name: Ward
combatTechniques.blurb: Set yourself against one kind of harm.
combatTechniques.effect: Choose one disclosed harm kind; reduce matching direct harm by 60% this round and next round.
combatTechniques.availability: Learn the named Training node for that person

terminology.name: Sigil
terminology.summary: A written symbol placed on a Page to help describe a world.

terminology.name: Subject
terminology.summary: The part of a written request that says what the request is about.

terminology.name: Focus
terminology.summary: A linked Sigil that asks the world to change its Subject.

terminology.name: Modifier
terminology.summary: A Sigil that changes how a connected Focus is applied.

terminology.name: Compound
terminology.summary: A reusable Sigil that preserves one complete written statement in a smaller footprint.

terminology.name: Route sketch
terminology.summary: Found writing that preserves one short path without revealing its destination.

terminology.name: Resource deposit
terminology.summary: A harvestable concentration of one world resource at a specific place.

terminology.name: Armour threshold
terminology.summary: The armour value above which a Gambit condition becomes true.

terminology.name: Village
terminology.summary: The home hub where the player prepares, builds, researches, and meets people between expeditions.

terminology.name: Shared progress
terminology.summary: Motes, Bestiary entries, and lifetime statistics kept across saves.

terminology.name: World preview
terminology.summary: A disclosure-safe preview of the world a Page may create before binding.

terminology.name: World pressure
terminology.summary: One named input—such as Hydrology, Illumination, or Growth—that helps shape generation without promising exact tiles or contents.

terminology.name: Normal world
terminology.summary: A standard generated world without a special authored starter identity.

terminology.name: Essence available
terminology.summary: The amount of refined Essence available at the point described. When a displayed total includes Raw Essence that could be refined, the copy must say ‘after refining’.

terminology.name: Worlds you can afford
terminology.summary: An advisory estimate based on stated Essence and a stated recent or current world cost.

terminology.name: World written by you
terminology.summary: A world created from the player’s own Page rather than a system-authored comparison.

terminology.name: Upgrade
terminology.summary: One learnable entry in Research, where every listed earlier Upgrade is required.

terminology.name: Skill
terminology.summary: One learnable combat ability; alternative earlier Skills may offer different legal routes.

terminology.name: Mastery
terminology.summary: A permanent campaign-wide improvement purchased with Motes through the Constellation.

terminology.name: Construction
terminology.summary: The physical build chosen for a piece of gear, determining its parts, appearance, and construction-dependent stats.

terminology.name: Expedition record
terminology.summary: The saved account of one expedition’s outcome and returned gains.

terminology.name: Saved at the time
terminology.summary: A value preserved when an event happened so later tuning cannot rewrite history.

terminology.name: From an older save
terminology.summary: Content retained from an earlier app version without pretending every current detail is available.

terminology.name: Writing found
terminology.summary: Writing brought home and retained as knowledge after an expedition.

terminology.name: Joined the village
terminology.summary: A person newly welcomed into the community after an expedition.

terminology.name: XP earned
terminology.summary: Experience earned by each party member, including any level-ups.
